dxf.units: mm ($INSUNITS 4); JSON coordinates stay in plan metres
dxf.R_RAUMPOLYGON: one closed LWPOLYLINE per room of 0.25 m² or more, islands cut out through zero-width bridges; made disjoint where rooms split along a stair outline overlap by a pixel; XDATA 'FPX' = room id
dxf.R_AOID: only AOIDs read on the sheet, unique and one per room, base point inside the room; never generated
dxf.R_GESCHOSSPOLYGON: one closed LWPOLYLINE per floor, voids over 5 m² cut out through a zero-width bridge
dxf.R_RAUMPOLYGON-ABZUG: voids over 5 m² (deducted from the GF and from the room containing them)
dxf.A_SCHRAFFUR: SOLID hatches of walls classed massive by a heuristic (see wall_construction)
dxf.V_BEMASSUNG: overall dimensions of the floor polygon, measured on the extracted outline
dxf.V_PLANLAYOUT: plan frame around everything drawn, title block
